data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Fay (AT1), advisory 29/2033Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY BECOMES A POST-TROPICAL CYCLONE. ...THIS IS THE LAST NHC ADVISORY ON THIS SYSTEM... As of 5:00 PM AST Tue Sep 29 the center of Fay was located near 23.7, -48.2 with movement WSW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1011 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 29/2034Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA STILL MOVING SOUTHEASTWARD WITH LITTLE CHANGE IN STRENGTH. As of 9:00 PM GMT Tue Sep 29 the center of Hanna was located near 34.0, -44.5 with movement SE at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1005 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 29/2342Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL FORECAST TO BECOME A MAJOR HURRICANE LATER THIS WEEK. ...GUSTY WINDS SPREADING ALONG THE COAST OF SOUTHWESTERN MEXICO... As of 6:00 PM CST Tue Sep 29 the center of Rachel was located near 16.6, -106.3 with movement NW at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 989 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 70 mph.

data.title: Remnants of Polo (EP2), advisory 30/0233Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO DISSIPATES OVER NORTHWESTERN MEXICO. As of 8:00 PM MST Tue Sep 29 the center of Polo was located near 30.5, -108.0 with movement NE at 23 mph. The minimum central pressure was 996 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 30/0233Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: TROPICAL DEPRESSION NINETEEN WEAKENS. As of 8:00 PM PDT Tue Sep 29 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 13.8, -130.2 with movement ESE at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.
